title: Cursor instructions
summary: Load your working agreement and count completed agent turns locally.

explain.what: Cursor hooks for the IDE and the agent CLI.
explain.does: Each session reads your current ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and adds a short Cursor note. The Usage page shows completed turns by selected model.
changes: ~/.cursor/hooks.json: one entry each for sessionStart, stop and sessionEnd
~/.agent-config-studio/cursor/hooks/: launchers, scripts, Cursor note and paths to Node.js
explain.undo: Uninstall removes installed hook entries and launcher files. Other hooks, entries you edited and local turn records stay in place.

workflow.strip: read your live working agreement and add the Cursor note to the session.

changes: ~/.agent-config-studio/cursor/hooks/: the launcher, script, Cursor note and path to Node.js
explain.what: A Cursor sessionStart hook for the IDE and the agent CLI.
explain.does: Each session reads your current ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and adds a short note on how to follow it in Cursor: yours in ~/.cursor/acs-note.md once you create it on Models, else the one this pack installs.
explain.undo: Uninstall removes the installed hook entry and its files. Other hooks and entries or files you edited stay in place.

parts.title: Completed turns on the Usage page

explain.what: Local counts of completed Cursor turns by selected model.
explain.does: The Usage page shows counts for today, the last 7 days and the last 30 days.
changes: ~/.cursor/hooks.json: one entry each for stop and sessionEnd
~/.agent-config-studio/cursor/hooks/turns/: launcher, script and path to Node.js
~/.agent-config-studio/cursor/turns.jsonl: timestamps, events, conversation and generation IDs, models and statuses
explain.undo: Uninstall removes installed hook entries and launcher files. Other hooks, entries or files you edited and local turn records stay in place.
